DML.SELECT: SELECT transit_id as "id", vehicle_type_id as "vehicleTypeId", vehicle_param_id as "vehicleParamId", value as "value", visible as "visible", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt" FROM rt.transit_vehicle_values
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.transit_vehicle_values ( transit_id, vehicle_type_id, vehicle_param_id, value, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( :id, :vehicleTypeId, :vehicleParamId, :value, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
